item.title: CONTAINERS QUARTERLY: Asia-Europe enters 2026 with seasonal firmness, structural uncertainty
item.description: The Asia-Europe container freight market entered 2026 on firmer footing after a volatile close to 2025, with seasonal pre-Lunar New Year demand and delayed GRI implementation pushing spot rates higher into early January.
